games.name: Piano Keyboard v1.1
games.desc:
A piano keyboard that you can play with your computer keyboard!

Added a limit to prevent playing an unreasonable number of notes. This won't (likely) boot people who bash their keyboards, but it will boot people who use programs to play lots of notes at once.

I highly suggest using sheet music if you are struggling. Otherwise, you may find this piano difficult to play as it is adapted to fit 61 keys on a computer keyboard.

Why not take a model?

- Engage in PVP and PVE to unlock greater abilities and become stronger.

CONTROLS (💻) 
W + W = Sprint
Q = Dash
F = Block
R = Substitute
E = Throwable
V = Carry
B = Execute
G = Activate Clan Mode
H = Activate Sub Mode
C = Clan Mode (Spec 1)
F + C = Clan Mode (Spec 2)
Z = Sub Mode (Spec 1)
F + Z = Sub Mode (Spec 2)
M = Menu
` = Inventory

CONTROLS (🎮)
X- Attack
B- Dash
Y- Sub
LT - Block
Left Stick - Sprint
RT + X - Weapon
Hold LT + RT + press LS - Shiftlock
Dpad down - Grip
LT + Dpad Left - Clan Mode 
LB + Dpad Left - Clan Spec 1
RT + Dpad Left - Sub Mode 
RB + Dpad Left - Sub Mode Spec 1
LB + RB - Skill Selection
RB - Skill Scroll Left
LB - Skill Scroll Right
RT - execute skills when selected
